Host and funder

The selected organisation is the research host. FAPESP provides the fellowship funding; applicants should follow the project-specific eligibility and submission instructions in the official call.

About the Fellowship

This FAPESP-supported fellowship involves artificial intelligence research linked to public management through CIA-GP. It is a postdoctoral project appointment and requires a recently completed PhD, with applications submitted under the advert's email instructions.

Research Areas

  • Artificial intelligence
  • Public management
  • Postdoctoral research

Funding and duration

ComponentDetails

Stipend / salaryFAPESP postdoctoral fellowship with a published allowance of BRL 12,570; confirm payment terms and eligibility in the official call.

CriterionRequirement

About São Paulo Research Foundation (FAPESP)

FAPESP funds research in São Paulo, Brazil, and publishes fellowship opportunities attached to research projects. Applicants follow the host project's submission instructions and the foundation's fellowship eligibility rules.

Official details: Read the programme or project information

Application route: Follow the official application instructions

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: 15 November 2026. Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.
